front.title: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
front.tldr: Anthropic has released two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, with gains in coding, reasoning and vision. The company says they also communicate more clearly with users.

front.title: Apple starts to charge for heavy AI usage
front.tldr: Apple has launched its first paid tier for AI features, starting with heavy usage of Logic Pro's AI tools in its Creator Suite, with more charges across its apps expected to follow.

front.title: 'Ramayana' becomes first Indian film to top UK and Ireland box office
front.tldr: Sony's animated "Ramayana: Rise of a Legend" took £2.1 million to become the first Indian feature ever to top the UK and Ireland box office, as "Godzilla Minus Zero" opened in third.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
stories.tldr: Meta has released Muse Ember, a lightweight model for agent tasks priced at 10 cents per million input tokens, undercutting frontier rivals such as Haiku and Luna.

stories.title: Locating the source of a mysterious beep with Claude
stories.tldr: Simon Willison used Claude to help track down an intermittent beep coming from an unopened box in his house, a small, neat example of AI as a practical troubleshooting tool.

stories.title: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
stories.tldr: Kuken Industries now uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

stories.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
stories.tldr: CodeRabbit now uses OpenAI's Codex and its own models to govern AI-generated code, letting its engineering team ship 20 times more software without growing headcount.

stories.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
stories.tldr: Geothermal company Fervo has lined up $12 billion in orders as it brings down drilling costs at its 8.4 GW resource in Utah, part of the wider race to power AI data centres.

stories.title: Automattic debuts a platform to deploy vibe-coded apps
stories.tldr: Automattic has launched Spacefast, a platform for deploying AI-built "vibe coded" apps, putting it in direct competition with Lovable and similar tools.

stories.title: Uber launches parking service following SpotHero acquisition, with an eye on robotaxis
stories.tldr: Uber has launched Uber Parking, built on its SpotHero acquisition, extending the app beyond ride-hailing and laying groundwork for future robotaxi operations.

stories.title: Drops brings back the fun of sharing songs with friends
stories.tldr: Drops is a new music discovery app that lets people scroll through 10 to 30 second song snippets, then comment on and share them with friends.

stories.title: Apple's new MacBook Pro touchscreen can be customised or disabled
stories.tldr: The new MacBook Pro with a PROLED XDR display ships with a touchscreen, a first for the line. Apple lets users customise it or turn it off entirely for those who prefer the old feel.

stories.title: Olivia Dean is Apple Music's Artist of the Year for 2026
stories.tldr: Apple Music has named British singer Olivia Dean its Artist of the Year for 2026, recognising her rise over the past year.

stories.title: Edgar Wright directs Apple's new Apple Pay action ad
stories.tldr: Apple has turned again to cinematic action to sell Apple Pay, with a new ad directed by Edgar Wright, best known for "Baby Driver" and "Shaun of the Dead".

stories.title: Apple Intelligence completes regulatory registration for iPad and Mac in China
stories.tldr: Apple Intelligence has cleared a regulatory step in China, ahead of its expected launch there on iPad and Mac this December.

stories.title: 'The Host' returns in a 20th-anniversary restoration from Bong Joon Ho
stories.tldr: Bong Joon Ho has revisited "The Host" for a 4K restoration marking 20 years since release, saying the 2006 monster movie's satire of official misinformation feels newly relevant.

stories.title: How 'Godzilla Minus Zero' brought King Ghidorah to life
stories.tldr: Producer Kazuaki Kishida and visual effects artist Tatsuji Nojima describe the detail work behind King Ghidorah's redesign for "Godzilla Minus Zero".

stories.title: Kris Bowers on scoring 'The Eyes of Ghana'
stories.tldr: Composer Kris Bowers says he wanted his score for the documentary "The Eyes of Ghana" to be a love letter to both the country and the history of film itself.

stories.title: George Lucas says Star Wars was never as good as the sci-fi film that inspired it
stories.tldr: George Lucas has said he expected the first Star Wars to be compared with "2001: A Space Odyssey", a film he felt was better and that heavily shaped his approach.

stories.title: Rebekka Karijord on scoring 'Tenzing' with Everest as the main character
stories.tldr: Composer Rebekka Karijord says Mount Everest itself became the main character in the music she wrote for "Tenzing", drawing on the film's Nepali setting.

stories.title: Joe Mazzulla reached out to Kristaps Porzingis after recent health update
stories.tldr: Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla says he checked in with Kristaps Porzingis after a recent health update, saying the centre "lights the room up" whenever he's around.

stories.title: The story behind Mike Conley's first Celtics start: 'I thought they were joking'
stories.tldr: Mike Conley found out he was starting for the Celtics not from his coach but from the teammates who picked him, in his 20th NBA season.

stories.title: Patriots waive rookie tight end Tanner Arkin, open spot on practice squad
stories.tldr: The Patriots have waived rookie tight end Tanner Arkin from the 53-man roster and released linebacker Jose Ramirez from the practice squad, opening two spots after Sunday's loss to the Packers.

stories.title: A.J. Brown expected to make the trip to Germany for Sunday's game against the Lions
stories.tldr: Patriots coach Mike Vrabel said he plans to have wide receiver A.J. Brown travel with the team for Sunday's game against the Lions in Germany.

stories.title: Piastri and management team mutually terminate agreement
stories.tldr: Oscar Piastri has ended his management agreement with Mark and Ann Webber, who have guided his career since his junior racing days. Both sides called the split mutual.

stories.title: Lawson closing in on 2027 F1 stay with Racing Bulls
stories.tldr: Liam Lawson is closing in on a 2027 race seat with Racing Bulls, built on a standout run of form over the Brazilian Grand Prix weekend.

stories.title: Ayrton Senna's rare Honda NSX smashes auction estimate with record sale
stories.tldr: A Honda NSX once used by three-time champion Ayrton Senna has sold for a record six-figure sum at auction, well above its £500,000 to £800,000 estimate.

stories.title: Payton Tolle finishes third in AL Rookie of the Year voting
stories.tldr: Red Sox pitcher Payton Tolle finished third in the American League Rookie of the Year vote, won by Kevin McGonigle, after a strong first full season.

finally.title: Watching the Sun's atmosphere pulse in extreme ultraviolet
finally.tldr: A new video edit uses NASA Solar Dynamics Observatory footage to show the Sun's atmosphere pulsing and flowing in extreme ultraviolet, graded and retimed by artist Seán Doran.
